description: A small kitchen set is in front, with a fridge on the left and an oven on the right, and several items on the counter including grapes, a lime, an egg, a mango, and two bananas. The right hand reaches to the fridge handle and swings the door open, then repeatedly picks up the grapes, lime, egg, and mango from the counter and places them onto the lower shelf inside; next it lifts one banana and sets it on the upper shelf, then moves to close the fridge door, while the left hand stays mostly resting near the counter edge.
